replies.author: Mooch24
replies.body:
Email support@avicus.net to make an appeal. The more forum posts and/or threads you create regarding your punishment will decrease your chances of being appealed. 

Aimbot has nothing to do with a bow. It's a client-side modification that forces your reticule to target the nearest players head.

Staff members can not ask for the other side of the story considering there really isn't one. Hacking is not allowed and it's your responsibility to know so. If staff members were to ask every accused hacker their "side of the story" not only would it take an extremely long time to punish anyone but it would also be an easy escape route for a hacker to turn off his modifications.
